0bffecdd-4722-5b01-b504-2baa99c85455.content: One of the user's identity documents needs renewal in the second half of 2025.

dbface5d-61f0-59e3-842e-2de0c60e7900.content: The user postponed an application until the next day after spending time looking for document photos in scattered folders.

13cd651f-a9be-5ef2-a1de-fed67c0b212c.content: After gathering the necessary copies in one folder, the user completed the renewal form in one sitting.

47e7d9a5-899b-5162-90ad-f9ca046e766a.content: The user entered an abbreviated name on an official form and then discovered that it differed from the supporting document.

1525cd77-3461-508e-9e4b-9c08bb128fd3.content: On the next application, after comparing the name with the source document, the user did not receive a correction request.

ed852985-aab8-5ed0-b73e-d04df1a9eb37.content: The user put only the submission deadline in the calendar and missed the application deadline by one day because they did not check the issuance period.

81dab4bd-5261-5c1a-90b3-75f53ace277a.content: On the next application, the user recorded the expected issuance date separately in the calendar.

beec91fd-acfc-52d1-8870-baa51ef79f10.content: Staff at a public-service counter expect a person requesting identity verification to bring an original as well as a copy.

df923b8d-5e20-5baa-b157-16b127bdd74d.content: When planning an official application, put both the submission deadline and expected issuance date in the calendar and verify them.

25458bc3-3968-5d74-a27d-dfece21e34b0.content: The local agent cannot determine the current validity of an identity document without its expiration date.
